heading: Choosing a kurta set

p: A kurta set (also called a kurti set or suit set) is a matching kurta with pants or palazzo – and usually a dupatta. It is the most versatile Indian outfit: simple cotton sets work for the office and everyday, embroidered or block print sets with a kota doria or organza dupatta work for pujas, festivals and day weddings. Every set here is stitched in our own Jaipur unit, in sizes XS–4XL or to your measurements for free.

list: Straight pants: the neatest look for office and travel.
Palazzo: wide and breezy – best for summer and long sitting.
With a dupatta: adds the festive touch for pujas and functions; without one it is easy everyday wear.
Cotton and pure cotton: breathable, easy to wash – everyday and office.
Kota doria and chanderi: light and slightly sheer – festive day events in summer.
Cotton flex and embroidered cotton: a dressier look that still breathes.

faq: What is the difference between a kurti set and a kurta set?
They mean the same thing in most shops: a kurta (or kurti) with matching bottoms, often with a dupatta. 'Kurti' sometimes refers to a shorter kurta.
Which kurta set is best for summer?
Cotton, kota doria or chanderi sets with a palazzo or straight pants – they let air through and stay comfortable in heat.
Can I wear a kurta set to a wedding?
Yes, for day functions such as haldi, mehndi or a puja – choose an embroidered or block print set with a festive dupatta.
Do kurta sets come with a dupatta?
Kurta pant dupatta sets include the dupatta; palazzo and pant sets on this page may not – each product page lists exactly what is in the set.
